name: Bola, Brutal
body:
Cost 15 gp Weight 2 lbs.
Damage 1d3 (small), 1d4 (medium) Critical x2 Type bludgeoning and piercing
Range Increment 10 ft. (thrown)
Category ranged Proficiency exotic
Weapon Group thrown
Special trip

These bolas function as standard bolas, but they deal lethal damage rather than nonlethal damage.
